name: Gluttony Support
description: Supports Projectile Spells you cast yourself. Cannot support orb skills, triggered skills, brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by things other than you.

stats: Gain 1 Gluttony on casting Supported Spells
On reaching 10 Gluttony, lose all Gluttony and gain Disgorge for 4 seconds
While you have Disgorge Supported Spells fire Projectiles in a circle
While you have Disgorge Supported Spells fire 5 additional Projectiles
